summary: First MVP test iteration. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passing (auth, dashboard stats, companies, customers/products, invoice lifecycle w/ LHDN validation & QR, .13 deterministic rejection, cancel-with-reason, MyTax role-app approve/reject flow, representatives default doc.view permission, intermediary date-range validation & doc_view default, users CRUD tenant inheritance, 17 roles catalog, audit grows, multi-tenant isolation across two tenants). Frontend: login lands on Dashboard with live stats (today/validated/rejected/total value/adapters), sidebar nav-* all present and navigate correctly, Cmd+K palette opens with cmd-new-invoice routing to /invoices/new, full New Invoice flow works — select customer, pick product auto-fills desc/price, Save & submit to LHDN transitions invoice to Validated with LHDN UUID + Long ID + Validation ID visible on detail page. Theme toggle removes 'dark' class. MyTax dialog opens with correct testids (ra-role-type/id-no/name/save-btn).

issues: 'Invoice date' and 'Due date' use the browser's default HTML5 date picker (input type=date with native calendar icon) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component used elsewhere. Recommend switching to shadcn calendar for consistency.
Section is labelled 'Lifecycle' but the review request/product spec refers to it as 'Timeline'. Functionally equivalent — consider renaming for consistency.
Console warnings: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for screen readers and is missing `aria-describedby`. Accessibility gap on Command Palette and MyTax dialogs.
Recharts warning on initial render: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — set explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native HTML5 date input in NewInvoice with shadcn Calendar for design consistency.
(Optional) Add DialogTitle + aria-describedby to Command Palette and MyTax dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
(Optional) Add ResponsiveContainer min-height on Dashboard trend chart to remove Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning.
(Optional) Consider renaming InvoiceDetail 'Lifecycle' -> 'Timeline' to match spec terminology.
critical_code_review_comments: server-side field naming: MyTax role-application backend uses `identification_no`/`applicant_name`/`applicant_email` while frontend testids are `ra-id-no`/`ra-name` — verify the frontend form maps to the correct backend fields (it does, but the naming divergence is confusing for API consumers).
Invoice submission uses FastAPI BackgroundTasks — poll interval OK; consider WebSocket / SSE for future real-time timeline updates.
seed.py + bcrypt: login endpoints working, JWT + Bearer auth verified.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly stripped (`_s()` helper) across mytax and other routes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, dashboard, sidebar navigation to 10 sections, command palette, new invoice creation + LHDN submission + validation with UUID, theme toggle, MyTax dialog)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed companies/customers/invoices and a second tenant TEST_Org_* via /api/auth/register. Not cleaned up (idempotent registration each run creates a fresh tenant).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend field naming to remember: /api/invoices requires invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD). /api/mytax/role-applications requires role_type (from ROLE_TYPES list: employer, company_director, tax_agent_admin_firm, representative_non_able, lawyer, estate_administrator), identification_no, applicant_name, applicant_email. /api/mytax/representatives requires identification_no (not id_no). /api/auth/register uses tenant_name (not org_name). Cancel invoice requires {reason: str}. Second-tenant registration via /api/auth/register successfully isolates data — verified admin cannot see foreign invoices.
rca_of_issues: No critical bugs found. Design-only observations documented above.
